_note: Paths eligibility (app/pai_c/paths/eligibility.py): whether the student can get into a path's study field from their education, shown as a badge on Paths and in the Compare table. It informs and never decides: any live path can be chosen. status_order sorts the statuses (best first). The check returns reasons as {key, values}; copy holds the English template per key ({name} placeholders are the reason's values; choose_group groups render as their route_label joined by group_joiner). education_line renders the student's education. compare: how many paths the Compare table takes. The frontend copy.json compare section mirrors this file (a test keeps them in step).
